title: Omega beams round 8: fiery lines, same physics to the hit, chase, under water
desc: Fiery red eye beams that keep the same switchback path all the way to the hit, stretch to chase fast targets, and leave bubble trails under water.

takes.name: Thin core + glow + embers
takes.facts: horse at 13 b/s, sides x1.19, head 2.2 b/tick; hit ticks 37-52

takes.name: + flickering hot spots
takes.facts: as L1 + hot spots running along the line; hit ticks 37-52

takes.name: + flaring corners, denser embers
takes.facts: as L2 + corner flares, 6 embers a tick; hit ticks 37-52

takes.name: Fast flyer chase
takes.facts: flyer at 30 b/s, sides x1.4, head 3.17 b/tick (95% of its speed); caught in its banking turn at tick 60

takes.name: Under water: sparse bubble bead
takes.facts: swimmer 6 b/s, 1 bubble a tick; hit ticks 32-34

takes.name: Under water: thin boiling sleeve
takes.facts: swimmer, 4 bubbles a tick hugging the line; hit ticks 32-34

takes.name: Under water: bubbles + steam
takes.facts: W1 + a steam puff at every corner; hit ticks 32-34
